_comment: Car-seat stroller adapter fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S3). Do NOT edit seed.json. Two-seat SET version of the Indie Twin car seat adapter (two car seats on the twin).
name: Bumbleride Indie Twin Car Seat Adapter, Set (Two Seats) – Clek / Maxi-Cosi / Cybex / Nuna
seatBrandsSupported: Clek (Liing, Liingo) / Maxi-Cosi (Mico Luxe, Luxe+) / Cybex (Cloud G Pro, Cloud G, Cloud G Lux, Aton G) / Nuna (Pipa Aire, Aire RX). Explicitly lists the Clek Liing — accepts two Clek Liing seats side by side.
_priceNote: $110 at Bumbleride DTC for the two-adapter set (out of stock at check; email-notify offered). Also sold via specialty baby retailers — reconfirm live.

install.pieces: set of two adapters (both side-by-side positions of the Indie Twin)
install.notes: Fits 2016–current Indie Twin. 2016–2023 strollers need 4 hot shoes fitted; current models ship with hot shoes pre-installed. Carries two infant car seats simultaneously.

notes: Indie Twin two-seat adapter SET, part MNCT-22; explicitly lists the Clek Liing and enables two Liings side by side (Bumbleride sells an Indie Twin + two Clek Liing travel system). $110 for the pair; DTC stock intermittent. Serves the two-car-seat Indie Twin config (bumbleride-indie-twin-two). Single-seat version is MNCT-21.
